exposure: VTE risk score (≥ 2 for mechanical prophylaxis, ≥ 3 for additional pharmacological prophylaxis)
cohort: 859 women undergoing caesarean delivery in a regional obstetric unit in China
finding: A local risk score model for VTE prophylaxis in women undergoing caesarean delivery was developed and found to be safe and practical, avoiding the need for large proportions of women to receive pharmacological prophylaxis.
